Fire at will.|Sniper receiving orders from Captain Kaido to fire into a crowd of protestors.|}} A [[human]] [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] '''sniper''' was deployed to the [[planet]] [[Ghorman]] where he fired the shot that started the [[Ghorman Massacre]] in [[2 BBY]]. ==History== [[File:WHO-WorldsWorstPerson.png|thumb|left|300px|The sniper takes aim during the Ghorman incident]] Serving as an [[Imperial sharpshooter]] for the [[Galactic Empire]], the individual was deployed to the [[planet]] [[Ghorman]] in [[2 BBY]]{{Andor|Messenger}} as part of [[Captain]] [[Kaido]]'s [[Ghorman crisis team|crisis team]]. Shortly after the crisis team's arrival on world, the [[sniper]] played a vital role in the Empire's plan to orchestrate a [[Ghorman Massacre|justification]] to fully seize the planet, with control over the world ensuring the Empire could begin mining its [[kalkite]]. The sniper's orders were to target a member of [[Sergeant]] [[Bloy]]'s [[Bloy's riot squad|riot squad]], composed of young [[Imperial security trooper]]s, while hidden, thereby making it seem as though the [[Ghorman (people)|Ghormans]] had fired first. Such would make the Imperials on the ground to think they had been provoked and make the Ghormans look like the aggressors.{{Andor|Welcome to the Rebellion}} The sniper was positioned on the roof of a building around the edge of [[Palmo Plaza]], where the sharpshooter would have a vantage point over a crowd of Ghorman protestors. During the protest, he received orders from Kaido to open fire and begin the conflict. He first targeted a member of a riot squad within the crowd and killed that [[soldier]] with a direct shot, which prompted Bloy, believing the shot had come from the Ghormans, to order his squad to open fire on the crowd. Members of a local rebel group called the [[Ghorman Front]] responded by firing back at the Imperial troops. As the shootout continued, the sniper proceeded to shoot several fleeing Ghormans from his rooftop position. ==Personality and traits== The sniper had light colored skin and [[Color|blue]] [[eye]]s. Despite being part of the Empire, he was willing to shoot an Imperial army trooper in order to start the Ghorman Massacre. ==Skills and abilities== The individual displayed skill as an Imperial sharpshooter, staying calm under the pressure of the Ghorman Massacre and following orders that entailed the death of a fellow Imperial. ==Equipment== During the Ghorman Massacre, he wore an all black [[clothing]] outfit with a hood and used a [[DLT-20A blaster rifle]] to fire into the crowd. ==Behind the scenes== The sniper was portrayed by [[Ali Watt]] and appeared in the [[Who Are You?|eighth episode]] of [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'' on [[May 6]], [[2025]].{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}} ==Appearances== *{{Andor|Who Are You?}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{InsiderCite|233|Andor Season 2 Companion|''Andor'' Season 2 Companion}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=უცნობი იმპერიელი სნაიპერი }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Imperial Army personnel of the Galactic Empire]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Sharpshooters and snipers]]
